notes.title: Time Controls Update & Additional Quality of Life Changes
notes.content: I updated the time controls menu as well as added a few features that will help your experience with the game. There was also a minor pack cost re balancing. Side note - obelisk was removed in favor of a new healing card yet to be added. Enjoy!

notes.title: Balance patch to make packs cheaper
Drum Patch
notes.content: The drum was not working past the 8th row so if you upgraded your defense length far enough you encountered this issue. Now fixed.

notes.title: Day 0 Patch - Thank you to bred_manguyboy, Alaric, Rizzler
notes.content: Thank you to the players listed above for filling out the bug report form. Their input went into helping the game with bug issues and resolving other problems future players might have otherwise experienced. This has been an exhausting day 0 but I am happy to say that I think I have fixed most of the big issues. Enjoy!
